note: Input schemas exactly as the connected account's MCP tools/list advertised them on 19 September 2026 (descriptions abridged). Read-only capture; no tool was invoked. None of voice_change, dubbing or video_analysis_create declares get_cost, and each declares additionalProperties:false, so no price preflight can be sent to them.

tools.name: voice_change
tools.description: Replace the spoken voice in a video with a different voice while keeping the original timing and visuals, then re-merge the new audio onto the video. Pass video_id for the source video (a confirmed uploaded media_id or a completed video generation job_id) and voice_id for the target voice. voice_type selects whether voice_id is a built-in preset voice ('preset') or a workspace reference element ('element'). This tool does not use prompt or count; output dimensions are taken from the source video automatically.

video_id.description: Source video. Confirmed uploaded video media_id or completed video job_id.

voice_id.description: Target voice id: a preset voice id (voice_type='preset') or a reference element id (voice_type='element').

voice_type.description: Whether voice_id is a built-in preset voice ('preset') or a workspace reference element ('element').

tools.name: dubbing
tools.description: Dub a video into another language: translate the spoken audio, synthesize it in the target language, and lip-sync the result back onto the video. Pass video_id for the source video (a confirmed uploaded media_id or a completed video generation job_id) and target_language as one of the supported language codes. This tool does not use prompt or count; output dimensions are taken from the source video automatically.

video_id.description: Source video. Confirmed uploaded video media_id or completed video job_id.

tools.name: video_analysis_create
tools.description: Start a scene-by-scene analysis of a video. Provide EXACTLY ONE of: (a) video_input_id - UUID of a video the user has uploaded via media_upload/media_confirm, or (b) youtube_url. Returns immediately with status='queued'; poll video_analysis_status until status='completed'. Processing typically takes 3-5 minutes on average. The longer the video, the less accurate the scene-by-scene analysis becomes.

video_input_id.description: UUID of the uploaded source video (the media_id returned by the upload tool).

tools.name: video_analysis_status
tools.description: Get the status and result of a video analysis. Poll this after video_analysis_create until status='completed' (scenes populated) or 'failed' (fail_reason populated). Analyses typically finish in 3-5 minutes - poll accordingly every 30-60 seconds.

video_analyze_id.description: UUID returned by video_analysis_create or video_analysis_jobs.

tools.name: video_analysis_jobs
tools.description: List the user's video analyses in the current workspace, newest first. Paginate by passing the previous response's cursor.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor - unix timestamp of created_at from the previous page.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List available voices for speech and voice tools. Returns built-in preset voices plus the user's own custom voices. Each voice has a voice_id and a voice_type ('preset' or 'element'); pass that exact pair to the audio models and to the voice_change tool to select the speaking voice. Use the preview_url to hear a sample. Paginate with the returned next_cursor.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor from a previous list_voices result).

tools.name: virality_predictor
tools.description: Virality Predictor: create starts analysis from a confirmed uploaded video or completed generated video; preview re-opens an existing dashboard. No non-submitting price form is advertised.
